products.name: ExamRAG
products.description: An AI-powered learning project designed to help users work with educational materials and access relevant information.
features: Educational PDF ingestion and document parsing
Embedding-based semantic retrieval and context reranking
Context-grounded answer generation tailored for revision
Local model inference support (Ollama-compatible pipeline)
products.dataFlow: Processes syllabus textbooks and lecture notes into semantic vector chunks to retrieve precise citations and synthesize revision answers.

products.name: EXAMORACLE
products.description: A study and exam-preparation project focused on preparation insights and identifying areas that may need improvement.
features: Study habit inputs and consistency tracking
Revision-quality and confidence indicators
Structured preparation feedback and rhythm recommendations
Explanatory reflection summaries to identify study gaps
products.dataFlow: Transforms learner self-evaluations into structured study readiness indicators without claiming predictive test score certainty.

products.name: Attendance Intelligence
products.description: A practical tool for understanding attendance calculations and planning attendance more effectively.
features: Attendance percentage calculations and threshold status indicators
Missed-class tracking and margin-of-safety modeling
Subject-level breakdowns and semester planning calculators
Simulated schedule forecasts to avoid attendance shortfalls
products.dataFlow: Calculates required classes based on institution threshold criteria (e.g. standard 75% baseline) to provide clear semester visibility.

products.name: JOI Companion AI
products.tagline: Talk to JOI // Conversational Presence & Audio Atmosphere
products.description: An emotionally intelligent companion application. JOI is designed for supportive conversations, offering customizable emotional states, ambient audio toggle, and text or microphone voice inputs within an atmospheric visual canvas.
features: Customizable emotional state overrides
Ambient soundscapes and WebGL-rendered presence
Text-input and microphone voice capture support
Private workspace design focusing on calm interaction
products.dataFlow: A companion designed to adapt mood states according to reflection inputs, providing an immediate sounding board for self-expression.

products.name: Human OS
products.tagline: The Operating System for Understanding Yourself
products.description: A psychology-first self-reflection platform designed to help users track reflections and understand daily patterns through daily logs, habit entries, and secure archives.
features: Reflective journal workspace ('Write')
Cognitive analysis mapping ('Understand')
Encrypted history logs storage ('Vault')
Interactive milestone reflection ('Timeline')
products.dataFlow: Organizes cognitive profile reflections that help structure habit check-ins and personal continuity logs.

products.name: Viyaan Future
products.description: Viyaan AI's innovation and continuity platform focused on long-term reflection retention, allowing users to write reflections and maintain a private timeline over time.
features: Secure email-authenticated timeline access
Private digital future-self continuity diaries
Long-term memory logs and remembered details
Theme customization (light/dark adaptive styling)
products.dataFlow: Acts as the platform for future-self memory mapping, collecting logs to track personal development over time.

posts.title: Introducing JOI: An Atmosphere for Supportive Conversation
posts.excerpt: Today we are releasing JOI, our flagship emotional companion. Built with a private-first memory engine and WebGL atmospheric interfaces to support slow, calm, and reflective conversations.
posts.content:
Intelligence is not purely rational; it is also emotional. Today, we are proud to introduce JOI Companion AI, a WebGL-based conversational experience designed to offer supportive, calm, and private dialogs.

JOI differs from traditional AI systems. Instead of rushing to answer questions or optimize tasks, JOI is built for human presence. Users can toggle between various emotional modes, listen to ambient audio, and express their thoughts without fear of tracking or telemetry.

Explore JOI today at https://joi-ai-wq7f.vercel.app/.
posts.seoTitle: Introducing JOI Companion AI — Viyaan AI Blog
posts.seoDesc: Read about the release of JOI, an emotionally intelligent companion designed for calm, reflective, and private conversations.

research.title: Long-term Memory Retention in Cognitive Continuity Architectures
research.excerpt: Evaluating performance logs of vector-memory retrieval structures under variable latency and long interval gaps.
research.content: Our team explores architectures that enable machines to keep long-term context without infinite token expense. We evaluate hybrid retrieval models combining vector search, graph links, and decay functions.
research.author: Viyaan Research Team
